steps.title: Model call 1 for understandable business: 2,186 tokens in, 200 out, ~$0.0008 at paid rates

steps.title: Model call 1 for durable competitive advantage: 2,147 tokens in, 129 out, ~$0.0007 at paid rates
details: The model decided to submit its finding: evidence weak, citing passage 1:26 sentence 1.

Its rationale: The filing identifies that the company owns a dealership in Japan covering approximately 80% of that specific market, but it does not provide a quantified measure of competitive advantage or market share for its global operations. steps.title: Model call 2 for candid management: 3,067 tokens in, 137 out, ~$0.0010 at paid rates

steps.title: Critic started its first pass
details: The Critic is a second reviewer, partly code and partly a model, that re-checks every explanation and quote.

steps.title: Critic: explanation check passed for 11 items

Critic: language check passed for 15 items

details: The model judged whether the quoted sentences support each finding's verdict and rationale.

steps.title: Critic: second-model review found 1 problem in 12 items
details: The Critic objected to the understandable business rationale: it says "the company earns revenue through financing services for these products", which the quoted sentences don't show.

steps.title: Critic sent 1 finding back for repair
details: Understandable business: rationale rewrite (the verdict stands, the rationale is rewritten from the quotes).

steps.title: Rationale rewrite for understandable business: 368 tokens in, 48 out, ~$0.0002 at paid rates
details: The model saw only the question, the verdict and the quoted sentences, and rewrote the rationale to say no more than they show.

New rationale: Caterpillar manufactures construction and mining equipment, engines, turbines, and locomotives. The company generates revenue by selling these products globally through a network of independent dealers and directly to other manufacturers.

steps.title: Critic re-checked the repaired items
details: Only the items that were sent back are checked again.
